title: Henly Large Leather and Suede Tote Bag
description_html:
Henly Large Leather and Suede Tote Bag by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 19.25”W X 13.5”H X 6”D
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Leather/suede
  • Hardware: Gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Snap fastening
